description: This file contains test cases for the simulation framework of a network project, utilizing pytest fixtures and custom classes to check simulation events, message passing, and algorithm execution within the 'sim' module. It defines test algorithms, fixtures, and test functions for simulation behaviors.

classes.name: Expect
classes.description: Helper class to manage and verify expectations during simulation tests.

classes.name: AlgorithmTest
classes.description: Test implementation of sim.Algorithm that checks specific start events.

classes.name: AlgorithmTestMessage
classes.description: Test implementation of sim.Algorithm that handles message passing.

methods.name: a_simulation(chain_network)
methods.description: Pytest fixture creating a sim.Simulation instance with a chain network.

methods.name: a_message()
methods.description: Pytest fixture returning a test devices.Message object.

methods.name: check_event(self, when, what, description, arg)
methods.description: Method in Expect class that checks if an expected event matches the actual event.

methods.name: add_expectation(self, when: Union[sim.Tick, int], what: str, arg: Any = None)
methods.description: Adds an expected event to the Expect object for future verification.

methods.name: event_callback(self, when, description)
methods.description: Callback for recording an event occurrence.

methods.name: timeout_callback(self, when, device, description)
methods.description: Callback for recording a timeout event.

methods.name: check_run(self, when, network, last_event)
methods.description: Verifies if an event occurred at the correct simulation time.

methods.name: check_done(self)
methods.description: Asserts that all expected events have been processed.

methods.name: start(self, when: float, device: sim.Device)
methods.description: Method in AlgorithmTest that records the start event and sets a timeout.

methods.name: test_simulation_event(a_simulation)
methods.description: Test function verifying a basic simulation event occurs at specified time.

methods.name: test_simulation_start_and_timeout(a_simulation)
methods.description: Test function verifying start and timeout events for algorithms attached to devices.

methods.name: handle_message(self, when, device, message, src, dst, src_link)
methods.description: Method in AlgorithmTestMessage that handles message reception and checks message type.

methods.name: test_message_unicast(tree_network, a_message)
methods.description: Test for message transmission from one device to another (unicast).

methods.name: test_message_multicast(a_simulation, a_message)
methods.description: Test for message transmission to multiple devices (multicast).

ctags.name: add_expectation
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_expectation(self, when: Union[sim.Tick, int], what: str, arg: Any = None):$/
ctags.signature: (self, when: Union[sim.Tick, int], what: str, arg: Any = None)

ctags.name: check_event
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_event(self, when, what, description, arg):$/

ctags.name: handle_message
ctags.pattern: /^    def handle_message(self, when, device, message, src, dst, src_link):$/
ctags.signature: (self, when, device, message, src, dst, src_link)

ctags.name: start
ctags.pattern: /^    def start(self, when: float, device: sim.Device):$/
